provenance.known_stage_a1_direction: deep topology metrics were more compact than exact-k fixed-q expectation
provenance.known_recurrence_result: deep k>=4 activation preferentially overlaps prior strong-chorus SiteIDs

question: Among deep clusters that activate both recurrent strong sites and other sites, are the additional active non-strong sites closer in route order to the active recurrent strong sites than expected after exact k, exact h and fixed q are represented?

population.taxon_state: Taxon acoustically silent across all ten drier stops.
population.prior_strong_mask: Strictly-prior CI>=2 at focal physical SiteID.
population.eligibility: At least one active prior-strong site (h>=1) and at least one active non-strong site (k-h>=1); prior-strong mask contains at least one and fewer than ten sites.

quantities.h: Observed number of wet active stops that are prior-strong SiteIDs.
quantities.core_distance: For each active non-strong stop, minimum absolute StopNumber lag to any active prior-strong stop; cluster metric is the mean of these minimum lags.
quantities.adjacent_to_core_fraction: Fraction of active non-strong stops at StopNumber lag 1 from at least one active prior-strong stop.

null.subset_weights: Among subsets satisfying exact k and exact h, probability proportional to product of fixed q/(1-q) odds for selected stops.
null.enumeration: Exact over all eligible ten-stop subsets.

primary_endpoint.support_rule: Observed mean excess below null 2.5th percentile, lower-tail plus-one P<0.05, and route-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound <0.
primary_endpoint.interpretation: Active non-recurrent sites lie unusually close in route order to activated recurrent strong sites, consistent with compact expansion around recurrent chorus cores.

secondary_fixed_endpoint.role: Corroboration only; cannot rescue a failed primary endpoint.

anti_tuning: Do not change k>=4 after readback.
Do not drop exact-h conditioning after readback.
Do not change core-distance definition, q source, prior-strong CI>=2 definition, bootstrap unit, seeds or tail after readback.
Do not promote adjacency to primary if core-distance fails.
